_about: Public-domain J. Lewis Diman, Congregational minister and professor of history at Brown University, for the Word Hoard: The Theistic Argument as Affected by Recent Theories, Orations and Essays with Selected Parish Sermons, The Nation and the Constitution, and The Alienation of the Educated Class from Politics. Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 126 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
